beats.text: On August tenth, signing an executive order that narrowed the childhood vaccine schedule from eighteen diseases to eleven, Trump made two claims his own party's doctors called nonsense.

beats.caption: They may be quite lethal, but individually they don't seem to be lethal at all
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: PolitiFact rated that Pants Fire. The MMR shot has decades of safety data behind it; combining it does not make it lethal.

beats.caption: looks like a bottle of soda in volume and is poured into a little child's body
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: PolitiFact rated this Pants Fire too. A real dose is about half a milliliter; a soda bottle holds almost six hundred. You'd need over a thousand shots to match his math.

beats.caption: So I don't know where he got this example with the soda bottle
beats.label: via AP Archive

beats.text: Translation: real doctors don't recognize his math, or his medicine.
